Course Coverage:
Financial Management
Time value of money – advanced concepts
Investment Appraisal Techniques
Technical and Fundamental Analysis
Risk Management – Options, Futures, Forwards and Risk Management
Learning Outcomes:
At the end of the course, the students would be able to:
1. Understand general and specific cash flows, based on which financial analysis is carried out
2. Apply investment appraisal techniques to determine the financial feasibility of the projects
3. Valuation of shares and bonds; determination of WACC
4. Use of fundamental & technical analysis to determine the value of a share / company / business.
5. Determine working capital requirements of a business and how to optimize the same
6. Advanced topics in Financial Management – including options & futures (to manage risk better)
